provenance: Repository-authored synthetic C25 negative cases; injected invalid states, no real secrets or credentials.

cases.description: Modifying a single byte in an audit event payload invalidates log root verification
Modifying a single byte in the checkpoint log root invalidates the cryptographic signature
Modifying a single byte in the base64 signature causes cryptographic signature verification to fail
When the separate checkpoint sink is offline or missing, status must be explicitly UNAVAILABLE
A checkpoint signed by an unauthorized key not in TrustPolicy must be rejected as UNTRUSTED_SIGNER
An older sequence cannot replace the current accepted authority (monotonically forward)
A replayed revision with the same sequence number as current authority must be rejected
A checkpoint whose timestamp exceeds TrustPolicy.MaxAge must be rejected as EXPIRED
A local hash chain alone is not immutable and cannot produce TRUSTED status without an authorized checkpoint
Checkpoints, audit events and verification payloads must never contain plaintext canary bytes
